# Game Idea: Neon Grid Runner

The player controls a small dot that moves automatically forward across an endless neon‑styled grid on an HTML canvas. Tapping or pressing left/right shifts the dot between lanes to dodge randomly generated spikes and moving walls. Collect glowing orbs for points. The game ends (lose condition) when the dot collides with any obstacle or falls into a gap. Simple controls, procedural generation, and clear lose condition make it quick to prototype on canvas.

1: // Simple Neon Grid Runner – targets <canvas id="game"></canvas>
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
5:   // audio context for sound effects
6:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
7:   // Helper to play a short beep
8:   const beep = (freq, dur) => {
9:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
10:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
11:     osc.type = 'sine';
12:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
13:     osc.connect(gain);
14:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
15:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
16:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
17:     osc.start();
18:     setTimeout(() => {
19:       gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.05);
20:       osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.1);
21:     }, dur);
22:   };
23:   // Ambient background hum
24:   const bgOsc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
25:   const bgGain = audioCtx.createGain();
26:   bgOsc.type = 'sine';
27:   bgOsc.frequency.value = 60; // low rumble
28:   bgGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
29:   bgGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.03, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.5);
30:   bgOsc.connect(bgGain);
31:   bgGain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
32:   bgOsc.start();
33:   const W = canvas.width = 400;
34:   const H = canvas.height = 600;
35: 
36:   const LANE_COUNT = 3;
37:   const LANE_WIDTH = W / LANE_COUNT;
38:   const PLAYER_RADIUS = 8;
39:   const PLAYER_Y = H - 50; // fixed vertical position
40: 
41:   let playerLane = 1; // 0‑left,1‑mid,2‑right
42:   let obstacles = [];
43:   let stars = [];
44:   let score = 0;
45:   let gameOver = false;
46:   let lastSpawn = 0;
47:   const SPAWN_INTERVAL = 800; // ms
48:   // generate background stars
49:   const spawnStar = () => {
50:     stars.push({ x: Math.random() * W, y: -2, size: Math.random() * 2 + 1, speed: Math.random() * 0.05 + 0.02 });
51:   };
52: 
53:   // Input handling
54:   const move = dir => {
55:     // resume audio context on first user gesture
56:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
57:     playerLane = Math.max(0, Math.min(LANE_COUNT - 1, playerLane + dir));
58:     // sound for lane change
59:     beep(440, 80);
60:   };
61:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
62:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') move(-1);
63:     else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') move(1);
64:     else if (e.key === ' ') e.preventDefault(); // prevent scroll
65:   });
66: 
67:   // Simple touch – taps on left/right half of canvas
68:   canvas.addEventListener('click', e => {
69:     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
70:     const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
71:     move(x < W / 2 ? -1 : 1);
72:   });
73: 
74:   const spawnObstacle = () => {
75:     const lane = Math.floor(Math.random() * LANE_COUNT);
76:     const spd = Math.random() * 0.12 + 0.15; // varied speed
77:     obstacles.push({ lane, y: -20, size: 20, speed: spd });
78:   };
79:   // spawn a background star
80:   const spawnStar = () => {
81:     stars.push({ x: Math.random() * W, y: -2, size: Math.random() * 2 + 1, speed: Math.random() * 0.05 + 0.02 });
82:   };
83: 
84:   const update = dt => {
85:     if (gameOver) return;
86:     // spawn obstacles and stars
87:     const now = performance.now();
88:     if (now - lastSpawn > SPAWN_INTERVAL) { spawnObstacle(); lastSpawn = now; }
89:     // occasional star spawn
90:     if (Math.random() < 0.05) spawnStar();
91:     // move obstacles
92:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
93:       const o = obstacles[i];
94:       o.y += dt * o.speed; // use obstacle speed
95:       // collision (simple circle‑square check)      
96:       const playerX = playerLane * LANE_WIDTH + LANE_WIDTH / 2;
97:       if (o.lane === playerLane && Math.abs(o.y - PLAYER_Y) < PLAYER_RADIUS + o.size / 2) {
98:         // collision sound
99:         beep(150, 200);
100:         gameOver = true;
101:         break;
102:       }
103:       // remove off‑screen
104:       if (o.y - o.size > H) { obstacles.splice(i, 1); score++; }
105:     }
106:     // move stars
107:     for (let i = stars.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
108:       const s = stars[i];
109:       s.y += dt * s.speed;
110:       if (s.y > H) stars.splice(i, 1);
111:     }
112:   };
113: 
114:   const draw = () => {
115:     // background with vertical neon gradient
116:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
117:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
118:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#003');
119:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
120:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
121:     // neon grid lines with glow
122:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#0ff';
123:     ctx.lineWidth = 1;
124:     ctx.shadowColor = '#0ff';
125:     ctx.shadowBlur = 4;
126:     for (let i = 0; i <= LANE_COUNT; i++) {
127:       const x = i * LANE_WIDTH;
128:       ctx.beginPath();
129:       ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
130:       ctx.lineTo(x, H);
131:       ctx.stroke();
132:     }
133:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
134:     // player dot with neon glow
135:     const px = playerLane * LANE_WIDTH + LANE_WIDTH / 2;
136:     const playerGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(px, PLAYER_Y, PLAYER_RADIUS * 0.2, px, PLAYER_Y, PLAYER_RADIUS);
137:     playerGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0ff');
138:     playerGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0f0');
139:     ctx.fillStyle = playerGrad;
140:     ctx.shadowColor = '#0ff';
141:     ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
142:     ctx.beginPath();
143:     ctx.arc(px, PLAYER_Y, PLAYER_RADIUS, 0, Math.PI * 2);
144:     ctx.fill();
145:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
146:     // obstacles (neon spikes)
147:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
148:       const x = o.lane * LANE_WIDTH + LANE_WIDTH / 2;
149:       ctx.save();
150:       ctx.translate(x, o.y);
151:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f0f';
152:       ctx.shadowColor = '#f0f';
153:       ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
154:       ctx.beginPath();
155:       ctx.moveTo(0, -o.size/2);
156:       ctx.lineTo(o.size/2, o.size/2);
157:       ctx.lineTo(-o.size/2, o.size/2);
158:       ctx.closePath();
159:       ctx.fill();
160:       ctx.restore();
161:     });
162:     // score
163:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
164:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
165:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
166:     // game over overlay
167:     if (gameOver) {
168:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
169:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
170:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
171:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
172:       ctx.font = '36px monospace';
173:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2, H / 2);
174:     }
175:   };
176: 
177:   let last = performance.now();
178:   const loop = () => {
179:     const now = performance.now();
180:     const dt = now - last;
181:     last = now;
182:     update(dt);
183:     draw();
184:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
185:   };
186:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
187: })();
